title: Datascene Golden Retriever Acquisition Package
description: Schema 1.0 for governed, evidence-linked and economically managed multimodal acquisition from web, local, repository, intranet, API, object-store and database sources.
x-datascene-invariants: All identifiers within each record class are unique.
Every referenced identifier resolves to a record in this package or an explicitly declared external package.
Every CaptureRecord refers to an existing SourceRecord and FetchAttempt.
Every CapturedAsset refers to an existing CaptureRecord or permitted analyst upload capture.
Every derived asset or analytical object has a TransformationRun with resolvable inputs.
Every non-ungrounded analytical object and entity claim has at least one EvidenceLink.
Every EvidenceLink resolves to a source, capture, asset or segment and carries a selector or whole-object selector.
Supersession and transformation lineage graphs are acyclic.
Restricted assets cannot be admitted to incompatible acquisition lanes or export classes.
Realized cost totals equal or exceed the sum of their nonnegative recorded components.
Credential references are opaque; credentials and connection strings are prohibited.
A repeated query or route attempt may reuse a unique capture but cannot silently erase the distinct FetchAttempt.
